decks.notes: This deck focuses on aggressive play, utilizing fast creatures and burn spells to quickly chip away at the opponent's life total. By constantly applying pressure and burning the opponent's creatures, it aims to win the game before the opponent can stabilize. Cards like Thundering Raiju and Bloodthirsty Adversary help to maintain a fast pace, while Feldon, Ronom Excavator and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance provide additional value. The deck also includes efficient burn spells like Lightning Strike and Play with Fire to remove threats and close out games.

This Rakdos Control deck focuses on disrupting opponents with removal spells like Abrade, Go for the Throat, and Cut Down while utilizing cards like Liliana of the Veil and Reckoner Bankbuster to control the board. Graveyard Trespasser and Bloodtithe Harvester help gain value from opponent's graveyards. Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Invoke Despair add additional disruption and advantage. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Gix, Yawgmoth Praetor. With a mix of removal, disruption, and strong threats, this deck aims to dominate opponents and control the game.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and aggressive creatures and direct damage spells. The key strategy revolves around using efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Phoenix Chick, along with burn spells like Lightning Strike and Play with Fire to quickly deplete the opponent's life total. The inclusion of cards like Squee, Dubious Monarch and Feldon, Ronom Excavator allows for card advantage and resilience against removal. Overall, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and finish the game quickly before the opponent can stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive red creatures and burn spells, dealing damage quickly before they have a chance to stabilize. The deck focuses on early game aggression with cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Bloodthirsty Adversary, while also including burn spells like Lightning Strike and Play with Fire to clear the way or finish off the opponent. With cards like Chandra and Jaya providing additional value and reach, the deck aims to close out the game swiftly and decisively.

This deck focuses on utilizing a combination of efficient creatures and disruptive spells to overwhelm opponents quickly. By playing aggressive creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Toluz, Clever Conductor, the deck puts pressure on opponents early in the game. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Ertai Resurrected and Shattered Sanctum allows for disruption of opponent's strategies. The deck also features powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Gix, Yawgmoth Praetor to close out games effectively. Overall, the deck aims to maintain board control and apply consistent pressure to secure victories.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game through counter spells, removal, and card advantage. By utilizing cards like Essence Scatter, Negate, Make Disappear, and Brotherhood's End, this deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and protect its own win conditions. Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Stern Lesson provide card advantage, while Reckoner Bankbuster and Cityscape Leveler offer powerful threats. The Mightstone and Weakstone help ramp up mana for bigger spells, and the land base ensures consistency in casting spells efficiently. Overall, this deck aims to out-value and out-control the opponent to secure victory.

This mono white control deck focuses on slowing down the opponent's strategy by using cards that prevent them from playing their key cards effectively. Cards like Lay Down Arms and Sanctuary Warden disrupt the opponent's plans, while creatures like Steel Seraph and The Wandering Emperor provide a strong defense. The deck also includes a few removal options like Banishing Slash to deal with threats. Overall, the strategy of this deck is to control the game and outlast the opponent to secure a victory.

The deck focuses on using various spells and creatures to control the board and disrupt opponent's plans. It utilizes counter spells, removal spells, and creatures with abilities that hinder opponent's strategies. The deck aims to control the game tempo, survive until late game, and then finish off the opponent with powerful spells and creatures. It also includes lands that provide flexibility and mana fixing. Overall, the deck aims to outlast opponents through control and disruption while building up a strong board presence to secure a victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing a variety of control spells and creatures to disrupt the opponent's game plan while building up its own resources. The main strategy revolves around generating and protecting key creatures like Steel Seraph and Elspeth Resplendent, while also using cards like Destroy Evil and Lay Down Arms to eliminate threats. With a mix of removal, card advantage, and efficient creatures, the deck aims to outlast the opposition and eventually overwhelm them with powerful board presence.

The main focus of this deck is to control the board through removal spells and tricky tactics, while also utilizing creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Bloodtithe Harvester to maintain dominance. The deck includes a mix of creature removal, land manipulation, and card advantage to outlast opponents. The strategy revolves around outlasting opponents by controlling the board and making strategic plays to disrupt their game plan. The deck aims to slowly wear down opponents while building up its own resources for a strong finish.

The main focus of this Grixis Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's strategy using a combination of removal spells, creature removal, and hand disruption. The deck also utilizes powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Corpse Appraiser to generate value and maintain board control. Additionally, the deck includes some versatile graveyard recursion and card draw options to help maintain card advantage. Overall, the deck aims to outlast the opponent while steadily advancing its own strategy to eventually secure victory.

The deck focuses on using a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and graveyard recursion to control the game and outvalue the opponent. It includes cards that can destroy creatures, counter spells, and manipulate the opponent's resources. The deck aims to stabilize the board and grind out advantage over time, eventually overwhelming the opponent with powerful threats and card advantage. It also utilizes the graveyard as a resource through cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Corpse Appraiser. The deck operates on a reactive strategy, waiting for the right moment to strike and take control of the game.

The main idea of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast, aggressive creatures and burn spells. By utilizing cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Bloodthirsty Adversary, the deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently. Reckless Impulse and Mishra's Foundry help keep the hand full of threats. Mechanized Warfare provides a way to pump up the team, while Kumano Faces Kakkazan and Lightning Strike offer direct damage to finish off the opponent. Squee, Dubious Monarch and Feldon, Ronom Excavator provide additional value and resilience to the deck's strategy.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and disruption spells to apply pressure on the opponent early in the game. Cards like Tenacious Underdog and The Wandering Emperor help to establish a strong board presence, while removal spells like Go for the Throat and Make Disappear help to deal with opposing threats. Additionally, cards like Siphon Insight and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse provide additional disruption and card advantage to keep the pressure up. The mix of creatures, removal, and disruption spells make this deck a fast-paced and versatile aggressive option in 1 vs 1 matches.

The main focus of this Grixis Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage. This is achieved through a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and card draw. The deck aims to control the board state through removal spells like Go for the Throat and Abrade, while also utilizing counterspells like Negate to protect key threats. The deck also includes card draw and advantage engines like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Wandering Mind to ensure that the player maintains resources and outvalues the opponent in the long game.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying creatures that can buff each other and work together to deal damage efficiently. It utilizes a mix of white and blue cards to create a strong aggro strategy, with cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben helping to disrupt opponents' plans while Siege Veterans and Valiant Veterans build up a powerful board presence. The inclusion of Mishra's Foundry and Adarkar Wastes allow for additional utility and flexibility in the mana base. The use of Recruitment Officer and Resolute Reinforcements provides additional creature support and the ability to quickly rebuild after board wipes.
